name: GDPR Readiness and Implementation Services
metaDescription: Improve GDPR readiness through data mapping, lawful-basis assessment, rights, DPIAs, processor governance, security and privacy-program implementation.

blocks.text: Translate GDPR Obligations into Sustainable Privacy Operations
Cybersentinels Consulting supports organizations that process personal data in a context subject to the EU General Data Protection Regulation

items: Request a GDPR Readiness Assessment
Discuss Your GDPR Requirements

blocks.text: The GDPR can apply to organizations established in the European Economic Area and, in defined circumstances, to organizations outside it
Applicability, Roles and Establishments
Assess territorial scope, processing context, controller and processor roles, joint-controller considerations and representative requirements for further legal validation
Records of Processing and Data Flows
Document purposes, data categories and individuals
Lawful Basis and Transparency
Review lawful-basis decisions, privacy notices, consent mechanisms and evidence with relevant business and legal stakeholders
Data Subject Rights
Design intake, identity verification and search
Privacy by Design and DPIAs
Embed privacy checkpoints into projects and establish screening and assessment processes for higher-risk processing
Processor and Contract Governance
Assess processor due diligence, Article 28 control needs and instructions
International Transfers
Inventory transfer scenarios and organize the operational inputs required for the selected legal transfer mechanism and risk assessment
Security and Breach Management
Align personal-data risk with technical and organizational measures, breach assessment and escalation
1. Applicability and Scope
Identify entities, establishments and services
2. Discovery and Mapping
Review stakeholders, systems and vendors
3. Gap and Risk Assessment
Evaluate design and operation of privacy practices and prioritize material deficiencies
4. Remediation Design
Define policies, procedures and control improvements
5. Implementation Support
Help teams operationalize records, notices and rights
6. Training and Testing
Train relevant roles and test selected workflows using realistic scenarios
7. Governance and Improvement
Establish reporting, review cadence and monitoring

blocks.text: Cybersentinels provides privacy readiness and implementation assistance, not legal representation
Can the GDPR apply to a company outside Europe?
Yes, in defined circumstances
Is consent always required under the GDPR?
No
Does having a privacy notice make us GDPR compliant?
No
Can Cybersentinels serve as our legal counsel or EU representative?
Our standard service provides advisory and implementation support
